edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, linking caller input to privileged state.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting it to owner.
transfer and transferFrom read and write balances[msg.sender].
approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom key the allowed mapping on msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] from caller-controlled input.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
Caller-controlled msg.sender/spender is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership authorization check on msg.sender gates ownership transfer.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping using safeSub/safeAdd.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance and then performs an external call.
transferFrom decrements the allowance with safeSub before mutating balances.
transfer routes its balance math through the SafeMath arithmetic operations.
transferFrom routes balance and allowance math through SafeMath operations.
approveAndCall invokes the spender contract via receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an owner-supplied token contract.
The called spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall before state effects settle.
The called token contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token.
External ERC20 transfer sends the tokens to the privileged owner address.
transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
transferOwnership must precede acceptOwnership in the two-step ownership handover.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the privileged owner slot.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
